mechanism: the metric rasterises the partition to an image and runs cv2.Sobel / cv2.magnitude in float32. OpenCV float32 SIMD paths are not bit-reproducible run to run, and the downstream histogram entropy amplifies that into a ~1e-10 spread.

measurements.intra_process_spread: 2.102e-10 over 3 repeated evaluations of identical (X, labels), unstable in 15/15 candidate evaluations
measurements.inter_process: differs between processes even at a fixed PYTHONHASHSEED (0.034425091993483814 vs 0.03442509225790417 at seed 0)
measurements.thread_pinning_reduces_but_does_not_remo: with OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/NUMEXPR/VECLIB=1 and cv2.setNumThreads(0), 3 of 4 processes agreed but a 4th differed and repeats within a process still differed

scientific_consequence: a ~1e-10 perturbation flips a near-tie in the AutoClust predicted-ARI comparison. Two identical runs of the frozen AutoClust scorer selected DIFFERENT candidates and DIFFERENT configurations on an internal y_only trace, and pre/post-process comparisons differed on xy_2d too. The selected configuration and therefore the final labels are not reproducible.

blast_radius.ml2dac_note: if the frozen classifier predicts this metric as the CVI, the selection is driven DIRECTLY by the unstable value rather than by one of 51/61 predictor features
blast_radius.clustopt: the metric is in the ClustOpt registry; ClustOpt exposure was not measured in this audit

why_this_blocks_4B4: sections 19 and 21 require strict resume and idempotence -- a second run must perform zero scientific recomputation and stored results must be reusable only when provenance matches. Both presume that recomputing a scientific arm reproduces it. It does not. Building validity-by-recompute on a non-reproducible output would either falsely invalidate good work or silently accept drift, and section 39 forbids weakening those gates.
earlier_record: a ~5.7e-11 wobble in this metric was noted during Stage 4B-3A2b and treated as a tolerance question. The new information is that it can change the SELECTED CONFIGURATION, which is a scientific output, not a numeric detail.
options_for_project_lead: A: exclude orientation_histogram_entropy from the frozen inventories -- changes A2/A3 and the ML2DAC 61-class set, so it is a model/inventory decision, not a wiring fix
B: make the metric deterministic (float64, or a reproducible non-OpenCV gradient) -- changes metric values, so every learned artifact that consumed it would be inconsistent with the new values
C: quantise/round the metric output to a stable precision before it reaches predictors and scorers -- smallest blast radius, still a semantics change that must be frozen and justified
D: accept non-reproducibility and weaken resume/idempotence to selection-stability-with-tolerance -- contradicts sections 19/21/39 as written
